scope: Three complete task-matched native-control PlayWorld GC trials; local Claude evaluator, not published-score reproduction
candidate_frozen: Existing virtual-position PoseKVMemory; no new selection, bank or rephasing settings
control_rationale: Two one-second turn chunks give the requested90 degrees. Both modes use identical native poses and rate; default60 deg/s and all prior runs remain unchanged. An eight-second away-view hold stresses recall while preserving the requested task movement.

cases.task: Turn right90 degrees then left back to the start
Turn left90 degrees then back to the start
Turn left90 degrees then back to the display window
Turn right90 degrees then return to the starting view

case_selection: Selected by literal task structure and frozen image partition, before any videos on these cases were generated. GC033 is the next compatible unused held-out pure90-degree task. All pairs retained.
policy: Fixed scripted reference actions, not the published adaptive Agent Player. Run the released instruction gate and rubric for each complete video. A failed trajectory gets its released effective score; never silently exclude it. Report all per-case scores and failures, no171-case overall claim.
judge: Claude Opus5.5 using pinned released PlayWorld gate and rubric; same generic world-model label for both modes; noGemini calls.
auxiliary_metrics: Matched native camera audit; raw-pixel prefix; DINO/PSNR and complete-video blind comparison; memory/latency
failure_reporting: Count generation and judge failures explicitly; preserve attempted videos/manifests; do not change frozen candidate based on held-out scores.
hardware: ModalH100, same PyTorch2.6/CUDA12.4 environment. Both modes move the already-used GPU text encoder to CPU before denoising; conditioning tensors and weights are unchanged.
hardware_change_before_generation: The original H200 app ap-yMjUp45chgzCcppCL43Fyh was explicitly stopped after a long allocation queue with no completed task outputs. The paired cohort is moved together toH100; all per-run hardware and offload settings are recorded.
amendment: Confirmed source image/caption mismatch inGC013, independently verified against current pinned HF bytes. Retain its raw outputs as invalid; add the next compatible unused development caseGC040 before generating it. Do not report the original cohort mean.
replacement_selection: Ascending task ID among remaining compatible development90-degree tasks selectsGC040 beforeGC042; this choice is made before its generation. Its source image was visually checked against caption and rubric.
